implementation: Iterative grammar-only recognizer supplies pinned Node 24.9.0 / V8 13.6 syntax prose after shipped QuickJS JSON.parse rejects; valid values remain VM-owned. UTF-16 locations, CRLF, context excerpts, literals/containers/numbers/escapes; source attribution and immutable inputs ship with hash-verified resources.

paired.comparison: Exact actual original parseIndexBody return objects, no prose normalization

body.comparison: Strict UTF-8/BOM, exact syntax and format-validation results

native.scope: Original captured diagnostic regression, full x86/x64 corpus equality, async worker ownership, HTTP, cache/listing/search and detail Remote direct consumers

first_failure.scope: Tail diagnostic inserted an extra in JSON; fixed. Initial direct-worker probe also omitted the production UTF-8-sig BOM removal; probe corrected. Raw comparisons retained.

verification.final_resource_check: Final exact corpus repeats after provenance-only CRLF normalization and manifest hash update; grammar bytes unchanged.

cleanup.removed: Owned test workspaces/home/tmp, duplicate generated bundles, downloaded reference source copies after retaining immutable identities
cleanup.retained: Commands/XML/logs, Source/native results, first mismatch, corpus and build/source hashes; shared Source/toolchains remain needed through C9

limitations: VM capacity/resource exhaustion remains a separate platform limit; the recognizer does not turn VM failures into successful values.
No full release gate or actual Win7 OS acceptance is claimed.
